passages.text: Chief complaint: back pain and right foot weakness.
History: back pain began 9 days ago.
Treatment so far: no physical therapy or medication trial yet.
Neurologic exam: new right foot drop, with weakness that has worsened over the past 3 days. Right ankle dorsiflexion 2/5.
Assessment: lumbar radiculopathy with right foot drop (M54.16, M21.371).
Plan: urgent MRI lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148).
